root_motion: MOTION owns horizontal displacement only; PELVIS holds full orientation including inversion. No yaw extraction singularity during a roll. Place the entire glTF scene in an instance wrapper.
ground_policy: Constant retargeted-neutral floor calibration only, retained across every frame. Source vertical travel and jump flight are scaled and retained. No target foot IK or per-frame body-floor clamp.
